projects.name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
New analytics dashboard initiative combining three data domains into one product: (1) data processing from customer CSV files, (2) log analysis from application logs, and (3) visualization components. The project is structured as five major milestones, each decomposed into tasks small enough to execute and review independently.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-engineering, observability, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Foundation, Requirements & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the shared foundation all three workstreams depend on: agree on the KPIs the dashboard must answer, choose the tech stack, define the data contracts between CSV processing, log analysis, and visualization, and stand up repository/CI scaffolding. Nothing downstream should start before the data contracts in this milestone are agreed.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Ingestion & Processing
tasks.details: Deliver a reliable pipeline that accepts customer CSV files, validates and normalizes them, and loads clean, queryable customer data into the analytics store. Covers intake, schema validation, error handling, transformation, and data-quality reporting for malformed or duplicate records.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Build the log analytics workstream: catalogue log sources and formats, ingest and parse application logs into structured events, and aggregate them into the operational metrics the dashboard will show (error rates, latency percentiles, request volume, top failure reasons). Includes retention and cost controls.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Design and build the user-facing dashboard: shared chart component library, customer analytics views driven by CSV data, operational health views driven by log data, and cross-cutting interactions such as filtering, drilldown, and export.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: Integration, Testing, Hardening & Launch
tasks.details: Bring the three workstreams together behind a query/API layer, prove it works end to end, and launch it safely: integration testing, performance validation, security and access-control review, deployment, monitoring, and documentation/handover.

tasks.name: Catalog dashboard KPIs and stakeholder questions
tasks.details: Interview stakeholders and write down the specific questions the dashboard must answer. Produce a KPI catalogue where each KPI has: definition, formula, source (customer CSV vs. application logs), grain, and refresh expectation. Deliverable: one short KPI spec document signed off by the project owner. This is the input to the data contracts task.

tasks.name: Select tech stack and provision environments
tasks.details: Pick the concrete stack for ingestion, storage, transformation, and the frontend charting layer, with a one-paragraph rationale and rejected alternatives. Provision dev and staging environments (or local equivalents) so the two pipelines and the UI have somewhere to run. Deliverable: short decision record plus working dev environment.

tasks.name: Define data contracts across CSV, logs, and visualization
tasks.details: Write the schema contracts that let the three workstreams proceed independently: canonical customer table schema, canonical log-event schema, and the metric/query response shape the dashboard consumes. Include field types, nullability, timezone and unit conventions, and versioning rules. Deliverable: versioned schema files committed to the repo.

tasks.name: Set up repository, CI pipeline, and code standards
tasks.details: Create the monorepo (or clearly separated repos) with directory layout, linting/formatting, pre-commit hooks, and a CI pipeline that runs tests on pull requests. Add a short contributing guide. Deliverable: first green pipeline on an empty skeleton branch.

tasks.name: Build CSV intake and file handling
tasks.details: Implement the entry point for customer CSV files: upload/landing-zone handling, file naming and size limits, encoding detection, and idempotent re-submission by file checksum. Deliverable: new files can be accepted into a staging area and tracked with a batch ID.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation and malformed-row error reporting
tasks.details: Validate incoming CSVs against the canonical customer schema: required headers, types, date formats, and allowed values. Route bad rows to a quarantine file with a per-row reason code instead of failing the whole batch. Deliverable: a validation report listing row counts accepted, quarantined, and why, backed by unit tests over sample good/bad files.

tasks.name: Implement normalization, dedupe, and customer identity resolution
tasks.details: Normalize validated rows (dates to UTC, currency and country codes, trimmed/uppercased keys) and resolve duplicate customers across files using the agreed business key, keeping the most recent record and recording merge history. Deliverable: deterministic dedupe with tests covering conflicting duplicates.

tasks.name: Build transformation and incremental load into the analytics store
tasks.details: Turn normalized rows into the canonical customer table and load them incrementally using upserts keyed on customer ID, so re-running a batch is safe and only changed records are written. Deliverable: a scheduled/idempotent load job plus row-count reconciliation between source and target.

tasks.name: Add data quality checks and reconciliation reporting
tasks.details: Add automated checks after each load: null rates on critical fields, duplicate rate, accepted-vs-quarantined ratios, and freshness. Surface results as a per-batch quality report with pass/fail thresholds and a failure alert stub so a bad customer file is visible before it reaches the dashboard.

tasks.name: Inventory log sources and document formats
tasks.details: List every application log source that feeds the dashboard (services, levels, environments) with a sample line for each. Document the current format(s), timestamp format and timezone, and volume per day. Deliverable: a log source catalogue that the parser task is written against.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion collector and delivery pipeline
tasks.details: Stand up the collection path from application log output into a durable raw log store, with backpressure handling, at-least-once delivery, and a small buffer for short outages. Keep it separate from parsing so either can fail independently. Deliverable: logs from one pilot service arriving in the raw store within a defined latency budget.

tasks.name: Implement log parser and structured event extraction
tasks.details: Parse raw log lines into the canonical log-event schema: timestamp, service, level, request ID, route, status code, latency, error type. Handle unparseable lines by tagging them rather than dropping them. Deliverable: parser with a golden-file test suite covering each documented log format plus malformed input.

tasks.name: Compute operational aggregates for the dashboard
tasks.details: Build the aggregation job that turns structured events into the metrics the dashboard needs: request volume, error rate, latency p50/p95/p99, and top failure reasons, bucketed per service per time window. Validate each aggregate against a hand-computed sample. Deliverable: an aggregate table refreshed on schedule with documented definitions.

tasks.name: Configure log retention, sampling, and cost controls
tasks.details: Set retention windows per storage tier (hot raw logs vs. warm aggregates), add sampling for high-volume debug logs, and put a budget/cost alarm on ingestion volume. Document what is kept where and for how long. Deliverable: retention policy applied to the pipeline with a cost estimate at expected volume.

tasks.name: Design dashboard layout, navigation, and design tokens
tasks.details: Produce wireframes for the main dashboard pages (overview, customer analytics, application health), fix the navigation model, and define colour/typography/status tokens including accessible contrast. Deliverable: reviewed wireframes and a token file the component work builds on.

tasks.name: Build shared chart component library
tasks.details: Implement the reusable visualization primitives: time-series line/area chart, bar chart, KPI stat tile, data table, and loading/empty/error states. Each component takes data via props only, with no data fetching inside, and gets a story or demo page. Deliverable: documented component library used by both dashboard views.

tasks.name: Assemble customer analytics views from CSV data
tasks.details: Compose the customer-facing analytics pages from the shared components: customer growth/retention, segment breakdowns, and revenue or activity trends sourced from the customer table. Wire to the agreed query interface using mocked responses until the API layer exists. Deliverable: customer analytics page rendering realistic sample data.

tasks.name: Assemble application health and log analytics views
tasks.details: Compose the operational pages from the shared components: request volume, error-rate trend, latency percentiles, and a top-failure-reasons table, all driven by the log aggregates. Include clear threshold colouring for degraded vs. healthy. Deliverable: application health page rendering realistic aggregate data.

tasks.name: Implement global filters, drilldown, and data export
tasks.details: Add the shared interaction layer: date-range picker, service and segment filters applied consistently across pages, click-through from an aggregate to the rows behind it, and CSV/PNG export of the current view. Deliverable: filters and export working across both dashboard sections with tests for the query-building logic.

tasks.name: Build query/API layer serving dashboard metrics
tasks.details: Implement the read API that both dashboard sections call: endpoints for customer metrics and for log aggregates, implementing the agreed response contract, with date-range and filter parameters, pagination, and response caching. Deliverable: documented endpoints returning correct results against seeded data.

tasks.name: Run end-to-end integration testing across all three workstreams
tasks.details: Swap the dashboard's mocked data for the real API and test the full path: CSV file lands → customer table updates → dashboard reflects it; logs arrive → aggregates update → health page reflects them. Automate the happy path in CI plus a small set of failure cases. Deliverable: passing E2E suite and a signed-off test report.

tasks.name: Performance and load testing with realistic data volumes
tasks.details: Test with production-scale inputs (largest expected CSV plus a representative day of logs) and measure ingest time, query latency, and dashboard first-paint. Define pass thresholds up front and record results. Deliverable: performance report with bottlenecks identified and a list of fixes or accepted limits.

tasks.name: Security and access-control review for customer and log data
tasks.details: Review where PII appears in customer CSVs and logs, confirm masking/redaction before storage, add authentication and role-based access to the dashboard and API, and check that exported files respect the same rules. Deliverable: checklist of findings with remediation items closed or explicitly accepted.

tasks.name: Deploy to production with monitoring, alerting, and runbook
tasks.details: Promote the stack through staging to production, enable dashboards and alerts on pipeline freshness, job failures, and API error rate, and write the on-call runbook (what to check, how to reprocess a bad file, how to roll back). Deliverable: production URL plus a runbook and handover session with the owning team.
